verdict.rationale: Semgrep includes AI features that work on the user's own scan findings. Semgrep Assistant post-processes findings with context to cut noise by about 20% (semgrep-gh-3). AI-Powered Detection flags business-logic flaws such as IDORs (semgrep-docs-6). The platform also claims to combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage and remediation (semgrep-docs-48). Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how Assistant presents its insights and fix suggestions, concrete evidence of AI-generated remediation suggestions beyond marketing taglines, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the built-in AI features.
